Record Class SalesReportData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.model.SalesReportData
Record Components:
orderCount - number of orders included in the report
totalSales - total sales revenue
averageOrderValue - average revenue per order
estimatedGrossProfit - estimated gross profit across the report
profitEstimateComplete - whether every item had enough cost data for a complete profit estimate
itemSales - sales totals and cost estimates grouped by item
dailySales - sales revenue grouped by date
paymentMethods - sales grouped by payment method
employeeSales - sales grouped by employee
public record SalesReportData(long orderCount, BigDecimal totalSales, BigDecimal averageOrderValue, BigDecimal estimatedGrossProfit, boolean profitEstimateComplete, List<SalesReportRow> itemSales, List<SalesTrendRow> dailySales, List<PaymentMethodSales> paymentMethods, List<EmployeeSales> employeeSales) extends Record
Aggregated data used to display a sales report.
